title: Stellar Blade demo, frame 59
images: This build: network every 4th frame, split over 4 frames
Reference: network every frame (about 3x the cost)
intro: Stellar Blade demo. Eve leaving the escape pod (full frame). Look at the flying particles and at Eve: no dark trails behind the particles and no dark spots on her. Open "About these pictures" for the setup and numbers.
about:
Setup

Stellar Blade demo: a captured game clip, 4K output, upscaler Quality (render 2561x1441), NR at full scale. Same settings as the 0.0.9-split.1 preview (its default preset, 1 pass; Stellar Blade with its own reuse settings: no revealed-background fill, Snap on). Every picture then goes through FSR 4 Lite lossy (4.1.2l-lossy, the 2026-11-19 build) at 4K.

What to look at

Eve leaving the escape pod (full frame). Look at the flying particles and at Eve: no dark trails behind the particles and no dark spots on her.

Numbers

Against the reference (PSNR, whole 4K frame): this build 40.0 dB on frame 59, NR off 31.9 dB; over the whole clip 42.3 vs 34.0 dB. Least close frame of the clip: frame 51, 39.5 dB.

Notes

Frames from captured game clips, run through the plugin's own runtime in a test harness (deterministic, one run each); the display mapping is ours (x/(1+x), gamma 1/2.2), not the game's tone mapping; no UI. Built on DLSSNR-AMD (TheAutomatic and contributors) and the RDNA3 ports by mauri870 and hedonemaeda. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by NVIDIA or AMD.
